_about: B6990: settings for the runner on the Secondary PC (BENJAMIN-PC, Ryzen 7 3800X 8 cores, 16 GB, RTX 2080 Super 8 GB). Keys here replace runner.json's. It drives lane 8 only, runs no book or Trove lookups (those files are on the Main PC), runs no stale-PR sweep (the main runner does), and watches the live site and the main runner. B7500 (19 Nov): while the Main PC is down with a hardware fault, this runner drives the merge train; runner.json has train off so the Main PC cannot drive it too when it comes back. To switch back, set train true in runner.json and false here.
name: secondary PC runner
